method: Independent joins and arithmetic from accepted YAML and independently checked source cells, without importing analyze.py. ICLG and podcast expected numeric values transcribed separately from primary publisher texts.
limitations: A fixed type/age panel reduces composition changes but does not measure net lessor profitability or guarantee constant technical specifications.
AVAC age ratios compare cross-sectional appraisal categories; not observed physical depreciation trajectories.
The 2026 rent/value ranges are descriptive gross monthly fractions, not financing yields. Midpoints are scenario choices, not sample averages.
HLMV valuation condition is not aircraft age.
Appraiser and publication methods differ; no CPI conversion is used in these nominal joins.
Podcast numerical evidence is a publisher-supplied transcript, not an independent audio transcription.
coverage_note: Baseline numerical joins, selected legacy primary cells, all 102 added AVAC cells, all 17 recent IBA observations, every direct trace quotation and final three-language article tables reviewed. This is not a new acceptance into production prices.
